svg.title: SMILE-FX HorizontalCompact logo, FullColor OnLight
svg.desc: SMILE-FX(R) official logo artwork. Geometry from the official Adobe Illustrator master (SmileFX-logo1, 2022); (R) set in Montserrat (SIL OFL 1.1). Compact lockup: descriptor and tagline removed; wordmark and (R) moved down 38.97 units so they centre on the S-mark. Do not alter.
